goal.reason: Repeated 180-second host-gate timeouts and sustained Defender/filesystem-monitor CPU. One eligible baseline, zero eligible optimized final samples; no final timing median or speedup is claimed.

changes: Disabled Ripple hosts skip listeners; enabled hosts share document release listeners, with synchronous re-enable and last-host cleanup.
Scheduler date/time formatters reuse Intl objects and invalidate when locale changes.

Import-only UI style facades flatten during their real Vite transform. CSS follows the normal compiler/HMR path. Memoization lasts one transform only; dependencies are registered before reads, including in-flight edits. Executable, cyclic, named and raw imports remain native.

Only the components plugin generated config.js absolute VueUse import is canonicalized, when it references the exact package already optimized by this site. Other versions and authored/raw imports are untouched.

revertedExperiment.change: Initialize docs theme before Vue mount

revertedExperiment.resolution: client.ts restored to its original onMounted initialization; final browser smoke checks dark selection survives reload.

protocol.cold: new process, independent empty temp/Vite cache and new Chromium context for each sample; HTTP cache disabled by routing
protocol.readiness: real custom client and theme menu, all 43 demo roots mounted, visible Scheduler, ancestor opacity >= 0.99, two animation frames
protocol.controls: Both variants retain all prior optimizations. Baseline loads the saved pre-change Ripple/Scheduler/MonthView sources through the normal pipeline, disables facade flattening and generated VueUse canonicalization. Client snapshot equals the restored final client. Baseline scope strings were mechanically updated after migration; APIs and mount criteria are identical.
protocol.caveat: CPU gates do not exclude filesystem I/O stalls. The eligible baseline alone is not enough for a fair comparison.
